Definitions, Purposes, And Procedures Of Educational
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a paper and pencil device used to describe or appraise human performances or products (Wolf, 1988)."
A rating scale is a paper and pencil device used to describe or appraise human performances or products (Wolf, 1988).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a longitudinal study in which subjects receive a sequence of different treatments (or exposures)."
A crossover study is a longitudinal study in which subjects receive a sequence of different treatments (or exposures).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the conceptual framework within which the research will be conducted."
A research design is the conceptual framework within which the research will be conducted.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are a type of longitudinal or panel study in which all participants participate in the treatment conditions."
Repeated measures designs are a type of longitudinal or panel study in which all participants participate in the treatment conditions.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to its ability to actually measure what it claims to measure, or what it was designed, or being used, to measure."
Validity of a test refers to its ability to actually measure what it claims to measure, or what it was designed, or being used, to measure.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the research method which takes into account several variables acting simultaneously instead of singly."
Multivariate analysis is the research method which takes into account several variables acting simultaneously instead of singly.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used when the data depart from the normal distribution and the measures can be nominal or ordinal."
Non-parametric techniques are used when the data depart from the normal distribution and the measures can be nominal or ordinal.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a collection of statistical models, and their associated procedures, in which the observed variance in the scores is partitioned into components due to the different explanatory variables."

Analysis of variance is a collection of statistical models, and their associated procedures, in which the observed variance in the scores is partitioned into components due to the different explanatory variables.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the most common types of longitudinal study."
Trend study is one of the most common types of longitudinal study.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used when you have two or more independent variables and want to know if an interaction is present."
Factorial experimental designs are used when you have two or more independent variables and want to know if an interaction is present.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a list of things or statements which a respondent has to go through and check (or mark) those that apply to him/her under the stated situation."
A Checklist is a list of things or statements which a respondent has to go through and check (or mark) those that apply to him/her under the stated situation.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used in settings where variables defining one or more 'causes' can be manipulated in a systematic fashion in order to discern 'effects' on other variables."
Experimental research is used in settings where variables defining one or more 'causes' can be manipulated in a systematic fashion in order to discern 'effects' on other variables.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the branch of statistics that deals with drawing an inference about a population on the basis of sample data from the population."
Inferential statistics is the branch of statistics that deals with drawing an inference about a population on the basis of sample data from the population.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are one of a family of designs in behavior genetics research which aid the study of individual differences by highlighting the role of environmental and genetic causes on behavior."
Twin studies are one of a family of designs in behavior genetics research which aid the study of individual differences by highlighting the role of environmental and genetic causes on behavior.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to investigate the joint effect of two or more independent variables on a dependent variable."
Factorial design is used to investigate the joint effect of two or more independent variables on a dependent variable.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the score which is obtained by more members of the group than any other score."
The Mode is the score which is obtained by more members of the group than any other score.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used they are interpreted in relation to the normal distribution curve."
Usually when standard scores are used they are interpreted in relation to the normal distribution curve.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a collection of systematic techniques for resolving apparent contradictions in research findings, by amalgamating, summarizing and reviewing previous quantitative research on a topic."

Meta-analysis is a collection of systematic techniques for resolving apparent contradictions in research findings, by amalgamating, summarizing and reviewing previous quantitative research on a topic.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the relationship between the normal distribution and the SD."
The point of interest is the relationship between the normal distribution and the SD.

survey method

direction of relationship
The direction of relationship refers to whether one variable increases as the other increases (positive), or whether one variable decreases as the other increases (negative).
______ refers to all the members or items under consideration in a research.
population
A population refers to all the members or items under consideration in a research.

Problems
Problems are the basis for research, and the first step in the research process is to identify a well-defined problem.
______ is used in studies where scores in more than two variables are to be correlated.
Multiple correlation
Multiple correlation is used in studies where scores in more than two variables are to be correlated.
______ is the statistic we most often use to measure the relationship between variables.
correlation coefficient
The correlation coefficient is the statistic we most often use to measure the relationship between variables.
______ is concerned with the study of past events.
Historical research
Historical research is concerned with the study of past events.
______ are used in analysis of variance to describe the degree of relationship between a predictor or set of predictors and the dependent variable.

Effect size measures are used in analysis of variance to describe the degree of relationship between a predictor or set of predictors and the dependent variable.
______ are used for checking achievement of the objectives stated.
Tests and examinations
Tests and examinations are used for checking achievement of the objectives stated.
______ are used for the controlled testing of causal processes.
Experimental research designs
Experimental research designs are used for the controlled testing of causal processes.

Correlation
Correlation is concerned with the degree of relationship between two or more variables.
______ is used to test for differences among sample frequency (nominal) data represented as frequency counts or percentages typically presented in a contingency table or cross-tabulation.
Chi-Square

______ is the theory of interpretation and understanding in different kinds of human contexts, religions as well as secular, scientific as well as that of everyday life.
Hermeneutics
Hermeneutics is the theory of interpretation and understanding in different kinds of human contexts, religions as well as secular, scientific as well as that of everyday life.
______ means that a test gives dependable or consistent scores.
Reliability
Reliability means that a test gives dependable or consistent scores.
______ is the act or system of methodically arranging a phenomenon in distinct divisions or classes.
Classification
Classification is the act or system of methodically arranging a phenomenon in distinct divisions or classes.
______ is a type of longitudinal design where data are collected over long periods of time, and measurements are taken on each variable over two or more distinct time periods.
Time-series design
Time-series design is a type of longitudinal design where data are collected over long periods of time, and measurements are taken on each variable over two or more distinct time periods.
______ is one of the most important and most common types of research in applied social research like educational research.
Survey research
Survey research is one of the most important and most common types of research in applied social research like educational research.

______ is the process of assigning numbers or other symbols to some attribute of a set of things in such a way that relationships of the numbers or symbols reflect relationships of the attribute being measured.
Measurement

Measurement is the process of assigning numbers or other symbols to some attribute of a set of things in such a way that relationships of the numbers or symbols reflect relationships of the attribute being measured.
